steps.caption: Option 6C · Sidebar filter. Search happens where the lists already are.
Type and every list narrows: Recent, and each type with a count and its matches as sub-rows.
Arrows walk the results; Enter opens, shift-Enter opens beside.
The last row searches inside pages: a results pane with the matching line, words in bold.
No dialog, no new place; Esc puts the lists back exactly as they were.
